title: Month-End Summary
generatePrompt: Select a month and click Generate
budgetManDaysColumnTooltip: Estimated time converted to working days.
actualManDaysColumnTooltip: Logged time converted to working days.
varianceManDaysColumnTooltip: Budget minus Actual. Positive means under budget; negative means over budget.
efficiencyColumnTooltip: Logged ÷ Estimated × 100. Under 100% means under budget; over 100% means over budget.
loggedHoursTooltip: Total hours logged via time tracking during this month.
tasksCompletedTooltip: Number of tasks marked as done during this month.
budgetManDaysTooltip: Total estimated time on completed tasks, converted to working days (estimated hours ÷ hours per working day).
actualManDaysTooltip: Total logged time converted to working days (logged hours ÷ hours per working day).
varianceManDaysTooltip: Budget minus Actual. Positive means under budget; negative means over budget.
efficiencyTooltip: Logged ÷ Estimated × 100. Under 100% means under budget; over 100% means over budget.
emptyFiltered: No data found for this period. Try selecting a different month or adjusting the filters.
emptyNoData: No data found for the selected period.
